name: Octopus
fact: An octopus has three hearts, blue blood, and eight clever arms.

name: Blue whale
fact: The blue whale is the largest animal known to have lived on Earth.

name: Sea turtle
fact: Sea turtles navigate vast oceans and many return to nesting beaches.

name: Clownfish
fact: Clownfish shelter among sea anemone tentacles.
